Healthy Creamy Chicken Kheema Pav | High Protein 

💪 42g Protein | 🔥 418 Calories | 🥑 15g Fat | 🥔 23g Carbs | 🌾 7g Fibre (per serving without pav)

👥 Makes: 3 servings

🛒 Ingredients

* 500g chicken mince (5% fat)
* 200g mushrooms, finely chopped
* 2 medium onions, finely chopped
* 2 tomatoes, finely chopped
* 1 tbsp ginger garlic paste
* 2 green chillies (optional)
* 150g Greek yogurt
* 1 tsp oil
* Fresh coriander
* Lemon wedges
* Whole wheat pav

🌿 Whole Spices

* 1-inch cinnamon stick
* 2 green cardamom pods
* 3 cloves
* 1 tsp cumin seeds

🌶️ Ground Spices

* ½ tsp turmeric
* 1 tsp Kashmiri chilli powder
* 1 tsp coriander powder
* ½ tsp cumin powder
* 1 tsp pav bhaji masala
* ½ tsp garam masala
* Salt & black pepper

👩‍🍳 Method

1️⃣ Heat 1 tsp oil. Add the cinnamon, cardamom, cloves and cumin seeds. Let them sizzle for 30 seconds until fragrant.

2️⃣ Add the onions and cook until lightly golden. Stir in the ginger garlic paste and green chillies. Cook for 1 minute.

3️⃣ Add the finely chopped mushrooms and cook for 5–7 minutes until they’ve released their moisture and reduced in size.

4️⃣ Add the tomatoes along with all the ground spices. Cook until the tomatoes break down and the masala becomes thick.

5️⃣ Add the chicken mince and cook until fully cooked, breaking it up as it cooks.

6️⃣ Lower the heat and stir in the Greek yogurt until creamy.

7️⃣ Finish with garam masala, fresh coriander and black pepper.

8️⃣ Serve with toasted whole wheat pav, chopped onions and a squeeze of lemon.

❤️ Save this recipe and tag me if you make it!

💡 Pro Tip: Finely chop the mushrooms and cook them before adding the tomatoes. They’ll release their moisture, concentrate in flavour and blend seamlessly into the kheema, you won’t even know they’re there.
